entries.title: Catalog setup lists you can change
entries.need: Catalog setup lists were fixed; Add only showed a message and products never used them.
entries.now: Product fields, units, tax rates and size charts can be added, changed and deleted, and the product form offers them.
try: Open Catalog setup, Units tab, add Carton (ctn)
Open Add product › Inventory, identifiers & units › Manage and pick Carton
Add a required field for Phones and save a phone without it
Delete Carton while a product uses it: it is refused

entries.title: One warranty policy list with versions
entries.need: Three different fixed lists of warranty policies; a new policy could not be made or published.
entries.now: One list: make a policy, save a draft, publish a new version, archive it. Products, Catalog setup and invoices read it.
try: Press New policy, name it, set 3 months, Publish
Open Add product › Warranty and pick it
Change the policy and publish v2; older sales keep v1

entries.title: Warranty claims from real records
entries.need: Claims logged on a customer or order never showed; the claim list and register count were made up.
entries.now: Claims list the real ones with steps from received to returned, search by IMEI, and the register shows every numbered unit.
try: Press New claim, type 864291057318404, Check warranty
Write the problem and open the claim
Move it to With service centre, then Ready for pickup

entries.title: Edit, archive and print a supplier
entries.need: A supplier's details could not be changed after adding it, and Print ledger only showed a message.
entries.now: Edit opens a side panel for contacts, terms, bank and bKash, opening balance and advance; Archive hides a settled supplier; Print ledger prints.
try: Open Kazi Power Solutions, press Edit
Add an opening balance of 5,000 and save
Press Print / PDF ledger

entries.title: Price comes right after photos
entries.need: Pricing sat below six specification groups, far down the product form.
entries.now: Pricing is the third card, right after Media; everything else stays in place.
try: Open Add product
Check Pricing sits under Media

entries.title: Shorter Inventory menu
entries.need: Inventory listed fifteen rows mixing stock, buying and warranty.
entries.now: Buying pages fold into one Purchasing row; warranty policies and claims moved to Products.
try: Open Inventory in the menu
Open Purchasing to see its five pages
Find Warranty claims under Products
entries.left: Barcode labels was not moved under a More group; it stays a plain Inventory row.

entries.title: No dead ends for one-place shops
entries.need: One-place shops were sent to a blocked purchase order page and saw held stock and 'in 1 places'.
entries.now: Buttons open New purchase, held and in-transit figures are hidden, and the place reads 'at Central Warehouse'.
entries.where: Inventory › Stock · /stock?edition=online, and a supplier page
try: Open /stock?edition=online
Check there is no Held figure or column
Open a supplier, More › New purchase

entries.title: Collect old dues at the counter
entries.need: Old dues could only be paid in the back office, behind the accept step.
entries.now: Collect due finds the customer, shows what they owe, takes cash or bKash (split is fine), pays oldest invoices first and prints a money receipt.
entries.where: POS › register top bar › Collect due · /pos
try: Open a shift, press Collect due
Pick Nusrat Jahan, take ৳1,000 cash
Print or send the money receipt

entries.title: Print the shift report
entries.need: Print report at End shift and in POS management only showed a message.
entries.now: The shift report prints on an 80 mm roll or on A4, with sales, money by method and the drawer count.
entries.where: POS › End shift; POS management › Employees and shifts › Report
try: End shift, press Print 80 mm
Open a closed shift's Report, press Print A4

entries.title: Own PIN and limits per role
entries.need: Everyone shared one PIN and one discount limit, so approvals could not be traced to a person.
entries.now: Each role has its limits (discount, price, refund, void, drawer, due); over them an approver enters their own PIN, which can be changed. Return & exchange and the phone register follow the same limits.
try: Set the seller's discount to 5%
Open a shift as Rafi and give 10% off
Approve as Rakib with PIN 1234

entries.title: Counter to-dos on Home
entries.need: Home's Needs you had no counter work for a shop with a POS.
entries.now: Needs you lists overdue dues, invoices to accept, a full drawer, offline sales, drawer differences and open warranty claims.
try: Open Home
Press Needs you
Open Warranty claims from the list

entries.title: Invoices only when money is owed
entries.need: Every counter sale with a phone became a paid invoice, and dues at the counter waited for acceptance.
entries.now: A counter sale becomes an invoice only when money is left unpaid, and it counts as accepted.
try: Sell at the POS with a phone and pay in full
Check Invoices has no new row
Sell on due and take a payment straight away

entries.title: Due says why it can't be used
entries.need: The Due button was greyed out with no reason.
entries.now: Due is always tappable; it explains why it is off and links to Credit & dues, or turns off full payment for that sale.
try: Turn selling on due off
Tap Due at checkout and read the reason
Open Credit & dues from the link

entries.title: Counter staff come from Staff & HR
entries.need: The POS had its own six names, so new hires could not work a counter and roles disagreed.
entries.now: Counter staff and managers come from Staff & HR and Team by role and branch; new hires show up.
entries.where: POS › POS management › Employees and shifts
try: Add a cashier in Staff & HR
Open POS management › Counters › Edit
Tick the new cashier for the counter

entries.title: Receipt shows the real shop
entries.need: The receipt always said Dazzle Shop with no address, phone, BIN or warranty.
entries.now: The receipt prints the shop from Settings › General, the BIN, and a warranty line under each IMEI item.
try: Change the store name in Settings › General
Sell a Realme phone at the POS
Check name, BIN and warranty line on the receipt

entries.title: Invoices and receipts settings
entries.need: There was nowhere to set the invoice number, look, footer or receipt width.
entries.now: Set the number prefix, invoice look, footer, BIN and warranty printing, receipt width and its last line.
try: Set the prefix to DZ- and the look to Brand colour
Sell at the POS and press Print invoice
Set the receipt width to 58 mm

entries.title: Customer order from profile opens POS
entries.need: Create order on a Retail customer's profile opened an empty register.
entries.now: The register starts the sale with that customer's name and phone.
try: Open /pos?phone=01553336655&name=Nusrat Jahan
Check the customer is set on the sale
